find: const identityMarker: IdentityMarkerStyle | null = opts.identityMarker ?? null;
why: The option's load-bearing default: an unconfigured HUD draws no mark, which every injected HUD in the suite relies on. The shipped FFA `shape` mark reaches a real page through `loop.ts`, which resolves the flag before this option sees it (issue #922), so a default here would be a second source for it: `solid`, which `loop.ts` resolves to `null`, would draw the mark anyway, since `??` cannot tell that `null` from an absent option, and every injected HUD would draw a mark no test asked for. Caught by the case that mounts an explicitly-null HUD beside a bare `createHud(root)` and asserts the strip's markup is byte-identical between them.
killedBy: hud: identity mark in the stock strip (issue #778) draws nothing at all without the flag, and leaves the strip byte-identical
